plans.idea: A banner that reads left to right: the bottle anchors the left, a wide centre column holds the headline and the three flavours at readable sizes, and a right column stacks the logo, the 'Build Your Pack' button and the two extra bottles, so the action ends the reading path.

Text first: the logo and a large text block on the left half give a clear brand-then-headline reading order, then the bottle with the 'Build Your Pack' button right under it, then the other two bottles on the far right to finish the three-flavour lineup.

Keeps the original's centred layout: bottles on both ends frame a centred column with the logo on top, then the headline and flavour copy, then the 'Build Your Pack' button at the bottom, the same top-to-bottom order as the portrait ad.
